changes.insertionHtml:
Foundayo UK approval and availability: latest position

Foundayo (orforglipron) was authorised in the UK on 10 August 2026. On 15 October 2026, the European Medicines Agency’s committee recommended EU authorisation; its opinion was published on 16 October. This is a separate European regulatory step. It does not confirm NHS funding, stock at a particular pharmacy or supply through SHIFT.

SHIFT supply is not confirmed. For the practical differences, compare Foundayo and Wegovy tablets, read our guide to weight-loss tablets for men, or use the tablet first-month plan.

Sources: MHRA, 10 August 2026; EMA opinion adopted 15 October and published 16 October 2026. Regulatory status checked 19 October 2026; this does not renew the review dates of other sections.
Taking the tablet? Read our oral semaglutide guide for the OASIS 4 evidence, fasting routine and first-month plan, then compare it with Foundayo.

Want to understand the Wegovy pill results? Our oral semaglutide guide explains the trial average and practical first-month routine. For the other daily GLP-1 tablet, read the Foundayo UK guide. Different trials do not establish which treatment will work best for you.
